name: myflicker-to-figma
description: 让 MyFlicker 用自然语言读写和编辑 Figma 原生设计。免费 Figma 账号也支持，具备文件编辑权限即可使用；支持原生动效，具体能力以当前账号和编辑器为准。生成结果可继续编辑，不消耗官方远程 MCP 调用额度。

scripts.test:upstream: node --test test/bridge.test.mjs test/runtime.test.mjs test/runtime-queries.test.mjs test/motion-specs.test.mjs test/figma-use-contract.test.mjs test/script-preflight.test.mjs test/page-performance.test.mjs test/authoring-upgrade.test.mjs test/context-upgrade.test.mjs test/operations-upgrade.test.mjs test/design-sync-upgrade.test.mjs test/project-index-upgrade.test.mjs test/recipes-upgrade.test.mjs test/recovery-workflows.test.mjs test/operation-history-upgrade.test.mjs test/internal-upgrade.test.mjs test/quality.test.mjs test/capabilities-upgrade.test.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:upstream
